turns.instruction: Analyze the attached beam. Report Uz at x=4.5 m and the left fixed-support reaction My. Use the attached input tables and OpenSees; include signed values, location, direction, units, case and current turn.

Move the UDL interval from x=2–7 m to x=3–8 m, retaining 12 kN/m downward intensity. Apply it only to the new 5 m interval. Keep the 9 m length, left fixed end and right vertical roller. Reanalyze and report Uz at x=4.5 m and left-support My.
